data.narrative:
Hyfix is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Mike Horton and Udan Ercan that has raised $15M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 same-sector and adjacent-stage comparables spanning both public equities (2 names) and private financings (8 names), including Series A companies Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI alongside seed-stage peer UFORCE.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 2.5x multiplier to the $15M raised proxy, implying a $38M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comparable set yields a $700M median valuation, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). The wide dispersion reflects material differences in stage maturity and reported traction across the defense-tech peer universe.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $32M to $805M, with a median estimate of $369M. This wide band reflects the tension between stage-appropriate pricing (seed-to-Series A progression suggests ~$38M) and peer benchmarking where defense-tech companies at adjacent stages command substantially higher valuations. Key uncertainties include Hyfix's revenue trajectory relative to UFORCE and other late-stage peers, product maturity, customer traction, and whether the peer set adequately reflects the company's specific technology and market position.
